fullPassage:
The Cambridge Declaration of Consciousness

In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. Consciousness means having subjective experiences or awareness. The scientists found that animals have emotions and can have consciousness like humans. For example, African grey parrots have shown evidence of consciousness that is almost as advanced as that of humans. Even octopuses have the brain structures needed for subjective experiences. Drugs that affect human consciousness also affect some animals in similar ways. So, the scientists concluded that consciousness is not just for humans. Animals can have it too.

Since the Cambridge Declaration, research on animal consciousness has been actively carried out. Scientists are still working to find out exactly how animal consciousness works. Not all animals are conscious, but those with complex nervous systems are more likely to be. All things considered, it would be a wise and safe choice to assume that animals have feelings and to treat them with respect and kindness.

questions.passage: In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. Consciousness ①<u>means</u> having subjective experiences or awareness. The scientists found that animals have emotions and can have consciousness ②<u>like</u> humans. For example, African grey parrots have shown evidence of consciousness that is almost as ③<u>advanced</u> as that of humans. Even octopuses have the brain structures ④<u>needing</u> for subjective experiences.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 주관적인 경험에 필요한(needed) 뇌 구조를 가지고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ needing → needed: 'structures needed for ~'에서 과거분사 needed가 structures를 수식. 뇌 구조가 '필요로 하는'이 아니라 '필요한' 것이므로 수동
❌ ① means: 주어 Consciousness(단수)에 맞는 동사
❌ ② like: 전치사 '~처럼' 적절
❌ ③ advanced: 'as advanced as'에서 형용사 적절
det.tip: 현재분사(-ing) vs 과거분사(-ed): needed for = ~에 필요한(수동). structures (that are) needed = 필요한 구조

questions.passage: Since the Cambridge Declaration, research on animal consciousness has been actively ①<u>carried out</u>. Scientists are still ②<u>working</u> to find out exactly how animal consciousness works. Not all animals are conscious, but those with complex nervous systems are more ③<u>likely</u> to be. All things considered, it would be a wise and safe choice to assume that animals have feelings and ④<u>treating</u> them with respect and kindness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 동물에게도 감정이 있다고 가정하고 존중과 친절로 대하는 것(to treat)이 현명한 선택이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ treating → to treat: 'to assume ~ and to treat ~' 병렬 구조. to부정사끼리 and로 연결
❌ ① carried out: 현재완료 수동태 적절
❌ ② working: 진행형 적절
❌ ③ likely: 'more likely to be' 적절
det.tip: 병렬 구조: to assume ~ and (to) treat ~. to부정사끼리 병렬 연결

questions.passage: In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. The scientists found that animals have emotions and can have consciousness like humans. Drugs ①<u>that</u> affect human consciousness also affect some animals in ②<u>similar</u> ways. So, the scientists ③<u>concluding</u> that consciousness is not just for humans. Animals can have ④<u>it</u> too.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 과학자들은 의식이 인간만을 위한 것이 아니라는 결론을 내렸다(concluded).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ concluding → concluded: 문장의 본동사 자리이므로 과거형 concluded가 필요. -ing는 분사로 본동사 역할 불가
❌ ① that: 관계대명사 주격으로 Drugs를 수식
❌ ② similar: 형용사로 ways를 수식 적절
❌ ④ it: consciousness를 받는 대명사 적절
det.tip: 본동사 자리에 -ing 형태 불가. 과거 사실이므로 concluded(과거형)가 필요

questions.passage: African grey parrots have shown evidence of consciousness ①<u>that</u> is almost as advanced as ②<u>that</u> of humans. Even octopuses have the brain structures needed for subjective experiences. Drugs that affect human consciousness also ③<u>affect</u> some animals in similar ways. Not all animals are conscious, but ④<u>that</u> with complex nervous systems are more likely to be.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 모든 동물이 의식이 있는 것은 아니지만, 복잡한 신경계를 가진 동물들(those)은 가능성이 높다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ that → those: 복수 명사 animals를 대신하므로 those(복수 지시대명사)가 필요. that은 단수
❌ ① that: 관계대명사 주격으로 consciousness를 수식
❌ ② that: 지시대명사로 consciousness를 받음 (that of humans)
❌ ③ affect: 주어 Drugs(복수)에 맞는 동사
det.tip: that(단수 대명사) vs those(복수 대명사). 복수 명사(animals)를 대신 → those

questions.passage: In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. Consciousness means having subjective experiences or awareness. questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용에 비추어, consciousness의 뜻으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 의식(consciousness)이란 주관적인 경험이나 인식이 있음을 의미한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 의식: subjective experiences or awareness를 가지는 것
❌ ① 무의식: 의식의 반대
❌ ③ 양심: conscience와 혼동
❌ ④ 결론: conclusion과 혼동
det.tip: consciousness(의식) vs conscience(양심) vs conclusion(결론)

questions.passage: Drugs that affect human consciousness also affect some animals in similar ways. So, the scientists ①<u>concluded</u> that consciousness is not just for humans. Since the Cambridge Declaration, research on animal consciousness has been ②<u>actively</u> carried out. Not all animals are conscious, but those with complex nervous systems are more likely to be. All things considered, it would be a wise and safe choice to assume that animals have feelings and to treat them with ③<u>contempt</u> and ④<u>kindness</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 동물을 ③경멸(→ respect 존중)과 친절로 대하는 것이 현명한 선택이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ contempt(경멸)는 원문 respect(존중)의 반의어로 부적절. kindness와 병렬이므로 긍정 단어 필요
❌ ① concluded(결론 내렸다): 원문 적절
❌ ② actively(활발히): 원문 적절
❌ ④ kindness(친절): 원문 적절
det.tip: respect(존중) ↔ contempt(경멸). treat with respect and kindness = 존중과 친절로 대하다

det.korean: 복잡한 신경계를 가진 동물은 의식이 있을 가능성이 더 높다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ complex nervous systems(복잡한 신경계): 원문 표현
❌ ① strong survival instincts(강한 생존 본능): 원문에 없음
❌ ② large body sizes(큰 체구): 의식과 무관
❌ ③ simple brain structures(단순한 뇌 구조): complex의 반대
det.tip: complex(복잡한) ↔ simple(단순한). nervous system = 신경계

questions.passage: In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. ❌ ① 2022년이 아닌 2012년
❌ ③ 증거를 보여주었다(have shown evidence)
❌ ④ 감정을 가질 수 있다(animals have emotions)

케임브리지 선언 이후 동물 의식 연구가 활발히 이루어지고 있다.

det.korean: 과학자들은 여전히 연구 중(still working to find out)이다. 이미 밝혀진 것이 아님.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 'still working to find out exactly how' — 아직 정확히 밝혀지지 않음
❌ ② 'has been actively carried out'와 일치
❌ ③ 'those with complex nervous systems are more likely to be'와 일치
❌ ④ 'a wise and safe choice to assume ~ and to treat ~'와 일치
det.tip: still working = 여전히 연구 중 ≠ 이미 밝혀졌다

det.korean: 연구가 활발히 수행되어 왔다(carried out).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ carrying → carried: 'has been actively carried out'에서 수동태(be + p.p.). carrying은 능동형이므로 부적절
❌ ① affect: 관계대명사절의 동사, Drugs(복수)에 맞는 동사
❌ ② concluded: 과거형 동사 적절
❌ ④ likely: 'more likely to be' 적절
det.tip: 수동태: has been + p.p. = ~되어 왔다. carry out(수행하다) → be carried out(수행되다)

det.korean: 존중과 친절(kindness)로 대하는 것.
det.analysis: respect and kindness(존중과 친절)로 대하라는 원문. 빈칸에 kindness가 정답
det.tip: kindness = 친절함. kind(형용사) → kindness(명사). -ness 접미사
